name: Felix's Box
summary: Felix Whindlebolt's box lies in Frostmane camps southwest of Anvilmar, far from the gnome refugee who lost it.

sections.title: Lost in the Flight from Gnomeregan
sections.body: Radiation swept through Gnomeregan during the failed attempt to purge the trogg menace, and Felix Whindlebolt fled with the gnomes into Coldridge Valley. In his rush to escape the fumes, he left his personal possessions and crafting gear along the snowy road. Frostmane trolls plundered the roadside goods before Felix could return. They carried his box, his chest, and his bucket of bolts to their settlements southwest of Anvilmar.

sections.title: A Refugee's Quandary
sections.body: Felix is unused to violence and poorly suited to Dun Morogh's wilderness, so he needs passing adventurers in Anvilmar to help recover his belongings. Getting them back would restore a measure of normalcy and the means to earn a living for the displaced artisan, who lost everything when Gnomeregan fell.

faq.answer: Felix's Box holds the personal belongings of Felix Whindlebolt, a gnome artisan who fled Gnomeregan after radiation spread through the city.

faq.q: How did the box end up with the Frostmane trolls?
aliases: why do trolls have felixs box
faq.answer: Felix left his gear while fleeing the radioactive fumes from Gnomeregan. Frostmane trolls took the roadside goods to their camps southwest of Anvilmar.
Felix Whindlebolt is a gnome refugee in Anvilmar, traumatized by Gnomeregan's fall and left without his tools and personal belongings.

faq.q: What other items did Felix lose?
faq.answer: The Frostmane trolls took Felix's Chest and his Bucket of Bolts along with the box, carrying all three to their camps southwest of Anvilmar.

angles.text: As a gnome starting in Coldridge Valley, you can bring relief to a fellow exile by recovering Felix's belongings after Gnomeregan's evacuation.
As an engineer, you know how hard it is for displaced gnome craftsmen to lose the tools and containers they rely on.
